## What

One or two sentences describing the change.

## Why

The problem or motivation. Link the issue.

## How

Notable decisions, trade-offs, and what a reviewer should look at first.

## Testing

Which level ran (`pnpm check`, `pnpm verify` or `pnpm verify:full`, see CONTRIBUTING "Checks"), new tests added, manual steps if the change touches UI, the `pnpm eval` table if a prompt, schema or provider changed, and anything required that could not run and why.
